prompts.prompt: AWS Glue is a managed service whose runtime evolves through versioned releases. What Spark version ships with the current Glue runtime, version 5.1? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/etl/skills/aws-glue/SKILL.md - Current runtime (Glue 5.1): Spark 3.5.6, Python 3.11, Scala 2.12.18, Java 17.

prompts.prompt: AWS Glue Flex execution is meant for non-urgent batch jobs that can tolerate delayed start times. What percentage cost reduction does Flex execution offer compared to standard execution? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/etl/skills/aws-glue/SKILL.md - Flex Execution: 34% cost reduction (0.29 dollars/DPU-hr vs 0.44 dollars).

prompts.prompt: When an AWS Glue crawler scans a data store, how much of each file does it read in order to classify the file format before applying classifiers? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/etl/skills/aws-glue/SKILL.md - Crawlers and Classifiers: Read first megabyte of each file to classify format.
